payload.description:
Researcher first-pass.

register-ref.py writes only to stories/WIKI-650fd9/references/. After project_key WIKI → ANTHUS, new assignments are ANTHUS-* but new refs still land on the old story. There is no --story flag.

Product rule: papyrus references register --backend local must take an explicit story (or a configured default corpus story), never a hardcoded id. A project_key change must not strand new refs on a retired prefix.
payload.title: local register hardcodes a story path; no --story
